benchmark_results.scope: C1 fixed-cell trajectory-disjoint tests in one 59-atom V_Sb1 cell: primary and independent split2, MACE-Q/MACELES-Q seeds 42/43; Polar primary-split heldout pending.
benchmark_results.interpretation: The primary split q=0/+1 ranking/selection failures do not reproduce on independent split2. Outcomes are strongly trajectory/split-sensitive; do not pool split metrics or claim an overall family winner. Both splits test same-charge distortion trajectories in a fixed cell, not charge, defect, or size transfer.

readout_ablation.scope: MACE-Q and MACELES-Q with direct embedding readout; seed42; same frozen C1 test split
readout_ablation.main_finding: No q=0/+1 ranking improvement; q=0 regret 0.2515 eV for both paired models; q=+1 regret unchanged at 0.5884 eV (MACE) and 0.5120 eV (MACELES).

two_seed_results.main_finding: On the primary split, seed43 repeats seed42 q=0/+1 failures for the same held-out paths. The independent split2 reverses that result with strong q=0/+1 rankings, demonstrating trajectory/split sensitivity; no overall family winner is established.
